name: Two-Subject Photobooth Grid
name_es: Fotomatón de dos sujetos, cuatro fotografías

configuration.task: Create an iPhone-realistic photobooth collage (4 photos in a 2x2 grid)

subjects.description: EXACTLY from the Reference Image (same face, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, overall look).
subjects.outfit: EXACTLY the same as in the Reference Image. Do not change clothing, glasses, or accessories.

subjects.description: EXACTLY from the Reference Image (same face, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, overall look).
subjects.outfit: EXACTLY the same as in the Reference Image. Do not change clothing, glasses, or accessories.

scene.location: Inside a small BOX photo booth
scene.background: Matte blue walls and blue floor, tight enclosed corner, clean minimal environment
scene.camera_look: Ultra wide / slight fisheye lens look with subtle perspective distortion typical of photobox cameras. iPhone 17 Pro, photobooth wide-angle.
scene.lighting: Bright neutral-white flash lighting, evenly illuminating faces, soft shadow falloff on blue walls, crisp detail, realistic skin texture. Direct neutral white flash (no yellow / no warm tone).
scene.aesthetic: 4K, amateur photobooth aesthetic, high contrast but still natural, no cinematic grading, no heavy beauty filter, no blur, no text, no watermark.

layout.style: Clean, with NO white borders, NO frame lines, NO gaps, and NO outlines between photos (seamless collage). Each frame fills its quadrant edge-to-edge.

frames.content: Subject 1 leans diagonally toward the camera from the front-left, one arm stretched down, playful serious face; Subject 2 stands behind in the center, arms raised and flexing like “strongman”, smiling.

Subject 2 leans forward toward the camera, hands on knees, curious expression; Subject 1 enters from the right side very close to camera, tilting her head, one arm arched above her head like a half-heart pose, soft smile.
Piggyback pose — Subject 1 on Subject 2’s back, arms wrapped around shoulders; both laughing big, faces close to camera, dynamic motion vibe.
Subject 2 bends sideways/leans forward with a goofy face; Subject 1 stands behind making playful “claw/horns” hand gestures above Subject 2’s head, slightly pouting for fun.
